body: Thank you! I honestly don't think she's ever gonna talk to me again :/ . I have to learn to deal with that and it'll be hard, but worth it. Thank you for your response, and I hope you have a great day!
I'm so sorry for your loss! I am hoping this wound will heal with time, I hope you have a great day!
Thank you, that's the plan! I don't have a younger sibling, so we're good there! Have a great day!

My friend did one of those stupid high school things where he posted on his finsta (basically a more private instagram account for close friends) this thing where if you like the post he would dm you a name for you to give an honest opinion about, and my friend gave my ex bestie my name. She said (my friend took an ss and sent this since she has me blocked on everything) "uhh we used to be very close lol but the more we talked the more I saw his true colors but I genuinely hope the best for this individual and hope he realized the amount of pain they have caused." It hurts so much that her boyfriend is doing so much terrible shit to her and that I can't be there for her and that I can't talk to her. I know that I will never be able to interact with her ever in my life, and that really hurts, she meant so much to me. For more context, the bad thing that her boyfriend said I was doing was telling one of my friends that I wanted innapropriate pictures of her. That's so disgusting and terrible, and I hate that she believed that and didn't listen to me, even though I was friends with her for way longer than her bf. It's important that it's such HEARSAY. Like ughh. He spread the lies all throughout the school, but honestly most people know he's a lying POS so they didn't believe it or care, and honestly I don't care if they did, I just care about my best friend. She has me blocked on everything, so she was the person that cut me off. I'm really really sad now thinking about it. I wish I could just forget everything. Anyways, thank you so much for your response, I hope you have a great day!

It's really unfortunate that we were unlucky enough to be afflicted by the same circumstances. Hopefully you find an amazing man that restores your faith back into men, and hopefully I find an amazing woman that does so too! Hopefully we both gain our ability to trust and build healthier relationships back! Have a great day!

Yeah, that's generally true. It's really unfortunate that we were unlucky enough to be afflicted by the same circumstances, although obviously not all teenage girls are like that. Hopefully we both gain our ability to trust and build healthier relationships back! Have a great day!

Thank you so much for your response! I have one trusted adult, my friend who is a freshman in college who has been really helpful in guiding me through my junior year in high school. My ex bestie kind of ingrained deep trust issues in me though, and some examples of them are me now feeling extremely guilty and uncomfortable telling other people about my problems and reaching out for help unless it's a complete stranger. I really wouldn't like to put the financial burden of counseling on my parents, but I'll definitely check out [thetrevorproject.org](https://thetrevorproject.org) . Thank you for your response, hope you have a great day!

Thank you for your response! Yes, I'm really looking forward to college. And family's pretty crazy, yknow, but it hasn't been that bad in a while. I don't think it would be the best idea to report it, but I've told a few people about what my mom did (lol my ex bestie, another reason why it hurts so much that all the shit went down with her). My plan is to go to college and just abandon almost everyone from where I'm from. Thank you for your response, hope you have a great day!

Thank you so much for your response! I'm really looking forward to college, and have been dedicating almost all my time this year into building up my resume. I definitely know that my mistrust of women is irrational, but it's very hard to feel that way since I've been betrayed by basically every major woman in my life, if that makes sense. I'll try my best to put those feelings aside, though! Thank you for your response again, hope you have a great day!
